# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

用户时间与预算有限，**每个任务都必须为省时间/省 token 服务**：

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

1: class_name NetBuffRow
2: extends Control
3: ## P3b：接管客户端的「buff 图标行」——复刻主机 UI_Manager 的 buff 行（collect_buff_rows /
4: ## BuffIcon / BuffInfo 详情弹层）同款几何与绘制：两行水平居中（上排=减益/控制/敌方印记，
5: ## 下排=增益/己方印记），复用 UI_Manager.BuffIcon（CELL 132×136/R52 的 2× 规格）。
6: ## 数据源 = host own.buffs（NetSession._pack_buff_rows，与主机 collect_buff_rows 同源，
7: ## 一行 cfg 展为 [key,glyph,[r,g,b],name,desc,remaining,total,steady,sub]）。
8: ## 只读复刻：不参与任何模拟，绝不回写 host。挂在 CanvasLayer 60（HUD 20 上、小地图 80 下）。
9: 
10: const CELL_W := 132.0
11: const CELL_H := 136.0
12: const BUFF_ROW_Y := 980.0       # 同主机 UI_Manager.gd：下排图标格顶边 y
13: const ROW_GAP := 6.0
14: const INFO_W := 460.0           # 同主机 BUFF_INFO_W
15: 
16: var _nodes: Dictionary = {}     # key -> BuffIcon（跨帧复用池）
17: var _info: Panel
18: var _info_title: Label
19: var _info_desc: Label
20: var _sel_key := ""
21: var built := false
22: 
23: func _build() -> void:
24: 	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
25: 	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
26: 	# 详情弹层（同主机 BuffInfoPanel：标题金字 + 说明白字，点击图标切换显隐）
27: 	_info = Panel.new()
28: 	_info.name = "BuffInfoPanel"
29: 	var frame := StyleBoxFlat.new()
30: 	frame.bg_color = Color(0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.94)
31: 	frame.set_border_width_all(2)
32: 	frame.border_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.18)
33: 	frame.set_corner_radius_all(10)
34: 	_info.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", frame)
35: 	_info.visible = false
36: 	add_child(_info)
37: 	_info_title = Label.new()
38: 	_info_title.position = Vector2(15, 10)
39: 	_info_title.size = Vector2(INFO_W - 30, 0)
40: 	_info_title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 18)
41: 	_info_title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.GOLD)
42: 	_info.add_child(_info_title)
43: 	_info_desc = Label.new()
44: 	_info_desc.position = Vector2(15, 40)
45: 	_info_desc.size = Vector2(INFO_W - 30, 0)
46: 	_info_desc.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
47: 	_info_desc.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
48: 	_info_desc.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
49: 	_info.add_child(_info_desc)
50: 	built = true
51: 
52: func _clean_tier(cur: Dictionary, keys: Array, y: float, vw: float) -> void:
53: 	# 一行水平居中排布（同主机 _layout_buff_row）
54: 	if keys.size() == 0:
55: 		return
56: 	var row_w: float = keys.size() * CELL_W
57: 	var x0 := (vw - row_w) * 0.5
58: 	for i in range(keys.size()):
59: 		var key: String = keys[i]
60: 		var node = cur.get(key)
61: 		if not node:
62: 			continue
63: 		node.size = Vector2(CELL_W, CELL_H)
64: 		node.position = Vector2(x0 + i * CELL_W, y)
65: 		node.visible = true
66: 		node.selected = (key == _sel_key)
67: 
68: func refresh(buffs: Dictionary) -> void:
69: 	if not built:
70: 		_build()
71: 	if not (buffs is Dictionary):
72: 		buffs = {}
73: 	var top_cfgs: Array = buffs.get("top", [])
74: 	var bot_cfgs: Array = buffs.get("bot", [])
75: 	var cur: Dictionary = {}
76: 	for c in top_cfgs:
77: 		_apply_row(c, cur)
78: 	for c in bot_cfgs:
79: 		_apply_row(c, cur)
80: 	# 移除本轮未出现的图标
81: 	for key in _nodes.keys():
82: 		if not cur.has(key):
83: 			var dead = _nodes[key]
84: 			_nodes.erase(key)
85: 			dead.visible = false
86: 			dead.queue_free()
87: 	# 两行水平居中：上排减益 / 下排增益（仅存在减益时也贴底排布）
88: 	var vw := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x
89: 	var bot_keys: Array = []
90: 	for c in bot_cfgs:
91: 		bot_keys.append(str(c[0]))
92: 	var top_keys: Array = []
93: 	for c in top_cfgs:
94: 		top_keys.append(str(c[0]))
95: 	if bot_keys.size() > 0:
96: 		_clean_tier(cur, bot_keys, BUFF_ROW_Y, vw)
97: 	if top_keys.size() > 0:
98: 		var ty: float = BUFF_ROW_Y if bot_keys.size() == 0 else (BUFF_ROW_Y - (CELL_H + ROW_GAP))
99: 		_clean_tier(cur, top_keys, ty, vw)
100: 	# 选中详情跟随刷新 / 消失关闭
101: 	if _sel_key == "":
102: 		return
103: 	if cur.has(_sel_key):
104: 		_update_info(cur[_sel_key], vw)
105: 	else:
106: 		_close_info()
107: 
108: func _apply_row(c: Array, cur: Dictionary) -> void:
109: 	# c = [key, glyph, [r,g,b], name, desc, remaining, total, steady, sub]
110: 	var key: String = str(c[0])
111: 	var node = _nodes.get(key)
112: 	if not node:
113: 		node = UI_Manager.BuffIcon.new()
114: 		node.key = key
115: 		add_child(node)
116: 		node.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP   # BuffIcon._ready 置 IGNORE，此处开启点按
117: 		node.gui_input.connect(_on_icon_input.bind(key))
118: 		_nodes[key] = node
119: 	var rgb: Array = c[2]
120: 	node.apply({
121: 		"glyph": str(c[1]),
122: 		"tint": Color(rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2]),
123: 		"name": str(c[3]),
124: 		"desc": str(c[4]),
125: 		"remaining": float(c[5]),
126: 		"total": float(c[6]),
127: 		"steady": bool(c[7]),
128: 		"sub": str(c[8]),
129: 	})
130: 	cur[key] = node
131: 
132: func _on_icon_input(ev: InputEvent, key: String) -> void:
133: 	var press := (ev is InputEventMouseButton and (ev as InputEventMouseButton).pressed and (ev as InputEventMouseButton).button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT) or (ev is InputEventScreenTouch and (ev as InputEventScreenTouch).pressed)
134: 	if not press:
135: 		return
136: 	if _sel_key == key:
137: 		_close_info()
138: 	else:
139: 		_sel_key = key
140: 		var node = _nodes.get(key)
141: 		if node:
142: 			_update_info(node, get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x)
143: 
144: func _close_info() -> void:
145: 	_sel_key = ""
146: 	if _info:
147: 		_info.visible = false
148: 
149: func _update_info(node, vw: float) -> void:
150: 	var txt: String = node.effect_desc

7: const FADE := 0.5
8: const GAP := 26.0
9: const ROW_H := 64.0
10: const ENEMY_C := Color(1.0, 0.33, 0.264)

14: var _items: Array = []   # [{actor:String, a_team:int, desc:String, victim:String, v_team:int, born:int(msec)}]

22: func _on_kill_feed(actor: String, actor_team: int, desc: String, victim: String, victim_team: int) -> void:
23: 	# host 开局链经战报通道转发的纯音频（SFX:: 前缀）：剥掉本地播、不画横幅
24: 	if desc.begins_with(SfxManager.ANN_PREFIX):
25: 		SfxManager.play_announce(desc.trim_prefix(SfxManager.ANN_PREFIX))
26: 		return
27: 	SfxManager.play_feed(actor, actor_team, desc, victim, victim_team)
28: 	_items.push_back({"actor": actor, "a_team": actor_team, "desc": desc,
29: 			"victim": victim, "v_team": victim_team, "born": Time.get_ticks_msec()})
30: 	if _items.size() > 5:
31: 		_items.remove_at(0)
32: 	queue_redraw()
33: 
34: func _seg_w(txt: String, sz: float) -> float:
35: 	return _f.get_string_size(txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, sz).x
36: 
37: func _draw() -> void:
38: 	var vp := get_viewport()
39: 	if vp == null:
40: 		return
41: 	var area := vp.get_visible_rect().size
42: 	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec()
43: 	var rows: Array = []
44: 	for it in _items:
45: 		var age := (now - int(it["born"])) * 0.001
46: 		if age < SHOW + FADE:
47: 			rows.append(it)
48: 	_items = rows
49: 	if rows.is_empty():
50: 		return
51: 	# 单行文本总宽（actor [desc] victim 三段式），逐行自顶向下铺开
52: 	for ri in range(rows.size()):
53: 		var it: Dictionary = rows[ri]
54: 		var a: String = str(it["actor"])
55: 		var d: String = str(it["desc"])
56: 		var v: String = str(it["victim"])
57: 		var a_team: int = int(it["a_team"])
58: 		var v_team: int = int(it["v_team"])
59: 		var ac := ENEMY_C if a_team == Config.Team.ENEMY else CYAN_C
60: 		var dc := Color(1, 1, 1)
61: 		var vc := CYAN_C if v_team == Config.Team.PLAYER else (ENEMY_C if v_team == Config.Team.ENEMY else PURPLE_C)
62: 		var segs: Array = []
63: 		if a != "":
64: 			segs.append([a, ac])
65: 		segs.append([d, dc])
66: 		if v != "":
67: 			segs.append([v, vc])
68: 		var total := 0.0
69: 		for s in segs:
70: 			total += _seg_w(str(s[0]), 40.0)
71: 		total += GAP * (segs.size() - 1)
72: 		var x := (area.x - total) * 0.5
73: 		var y := 90.0 + ri * ROW_H
74: 		var age := (now - int(it["born"])) * 0.001
75: 		var alpha := 1.0 if age < SHOW else clampf(1.0 - (age - SHOW) / FADE, 0.0, 1.0)
76: 		var sh := Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5 * alpha)
77: 		for s in segs:
78: 			var txt: String = str(s[0])
79: 			var col: Color = s[1]
80: 			col.a = alpha
81: 			draw_string(_f, Vector2(x + 2, y + 2), txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 40.0, sh)
82: 			draw_string(_f, Vector2(x, y), txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 40.0, col)

1: class_name NetDeathRecap extends Control
2: ## P3e 死亡回放：host 死亡跃迁推一次聚合 payload（受控时长 + 近7秒伤害），客户端全屏压暗 + 居中面板复刻
3: ## 主机 _show_death_recap：前段「逐击明细」（来源/-伤害/暴击 tag/技能名/时间）+ 后段「按来源+技能汇总条形」。
4: ## 这里镜像两段；面板超高时内容区滚轮滚动。alive 回 1（复活）自动复位关闭；Esc/×/点遮罩可关。
5: 
6: const PANEL_W := 560.0
7: const BAR_W := 40.0
8: const BAR_H := 110.0
9: const LOG_H := 22.0    # 逐击明细行高
10: const SRC_BLOCK := 214.0   # 每个来源汇总块高（标题30 + 条形区 + 总计行，含呼吸）
11: 
12: var _payload := {}       # 最近一次收到 {"cc":float,"rows":[...],"log":[...]}
13: var _alive := 1
14: var _closed := false     # 本死亡手动关过 → 复活后复位
15: var _scroll := 0.0       # 内容区滚轮偏移（超高时可滚）
16: var _f := ThemeDB.fallback_font
17: 
18: func _ready() -> void:
19: 	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
20: 	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
21: 	visible = false
22: 	NetSession.net_death_recap.connect(_on_recap)
23: 
24: func _on_recap(p: Dictionary) -> void:
25: 	_payload = p
26: 	_closed = false
27: 	_scroll = 0.0
28: 	visible = true
29: 	queue_redraw()
30: 
31: func feed_alive(alive: int) -> void:
32: 	if _alive == 1 and alive == 0:
33: 		pass   # 死亡瞬间：等待 host 推送（快照先到亦无事，payload 到达再显示）
34: 	if _alive == 0 and alive == 1:
35: 		_alive = alive
36: 		_payload = {}
37: 		_closed = false
38: 		_scroll = 0.0
39: 		visible = false
40: 		queue_redraw()
41: 		return
42: 	_alive = alive
43: 
44: func _close() -> void:
45: 	visible = false
46: 	_closed = true
47: 
48: # ---------- 布局（内容几何，供 _draw 与 _gui_input 共用） ----------
49: 
50: func _content_h() -> float:
51: 	var rows: Array = _payload.get("rows", [])
52: 	var log_a: Array = _payload.get("log", [])
53: 	var h := 0.0
54: 	if not log_a.is_empty():
55: 		h += 36.0 + log_a.size() * LOG_H + 10.0
56: 	h += rows.size() * SRC_BLOCK
57: 	return h
58: 
59: func _panel_rect(area: Vector2, content_h: float) -> Rect2:
60: 	var max_h := minf(150.0 + content_h, area.y * 0.94)
61: 	return Rect2((area.x - PANEL_W) * 0.5, (area.y - max_h) * 0.5, PANEL_W, max_h)
62: 
63: # ---------- 绘制 ----------
64: 
65: func _text(pos: Vector2, txt: String, sz: int, col: Color) -> void:
66: 	draw_string(_f, pos + Vector2(1.5, 1.5), txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, sz, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5))
67: 	draw_string(_f, pos, txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, sz, col)
68: 
69: func _draw() -> void:
70: 	if not visible:
71: 		return
72: 	var vp := get_viewport()
73: 	if vp == null:
74: 		return
75: 	var area := vp.get_visible_rect().size
76: 	draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, area), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55))
77: 	var rows: Array = _payload.get("rows", [])
78: 	var log_a: Array = _payload.get("log", [])
79: 	var cc := float(_payload.get("cc", 0.0))
80: 	var content_h := _content_h()
81: 	var panel := _panel_rect(area, content_h)
82: 	draw_rect(panel, Color(0.015, 0.035, 0.08, 0.95))
83: 	draw_rect(panel, Color(0.9, 0.2, 0.2, 0.85), false, 3.0)
84: 	var x := panel.position.x
85: 	_text(Vector2(x + 24, panel.position.y + 36), "死亡回放 (近7秒)", 26, Color(1, 0.4, 0.4))
86: 	_text(Vector2(x + 24, panel.position.y + 76), "受控时长: %.1f 秒" % cc, 20, Color(0.82, 0.6, 1.0))
87: 	# 关闭 ✕ 命中（右上）
88: 	var close_r := Rect2(panel.position.x + PANEL_W - 70.0, panel.position.y + 10.0, 56.0, 56.0)
89: 	_text(Vector2(close_r.position.x + 14.0, close_r.position.y + 40.0), "×", 34, Color(1, 1, 1))
90: 	# 内容区（固定头部下方，超高可滚）
91: 	var y0 := panel.position.y + 150.0
92: 	var win_h := maxf(0.0, panel.size.y - 150.0 - 14.0)
93: 	var scroll_max := maxf(0.0, content_h - win_h)
94: 	if _scroll > scroll_max:
95: 		_scroll = scroll_max
96: 	var c := y0 - _scroll
97: 	var win_bot := y0 + win_h
98: 	# 前段：逐击明细
99: 	if not log_a.is_empty():
100: 		if c + 22.0 >= y0 and c < win_bot:
101: 			_text(Vector2(x + 24, c + 22.0), "攻击记录", 18, Color(1, 1, 1))
102: 		c += 34.0
103: 		for lg in log_a:
104: 			if c + LOG_H >= y0 and c < win_bot:
105: 				_draw_log_row(x, c, lg)
106: 			c += LOG_H
107: 		c += 8.0
108: 	# 分隔线
109: 	if c + 6.0 - 3.0 < win_bot:
110: 		draw_rect(Rect2(x + 20, c + 3.0, PANEL_W - 40, 1.0), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.25))
111: 	# 后段：按来源+技能汇总条形
112: 	for row in rows:
113: 		if c + SRC_BLOCK >= y0 and c < win_bot:
114: 			_draw_source_block(x, c, row)
115: 		c += SRC_BLOCK
116: 	if rows.is_empty() and log_a.is_empty():
117: 		_text(Vector2(x + 24, y0 + 8.0), "（近7秒无伤害记录）", 18, Color(0.7, 0.7, 0.7))
118: 
119: func _draw_log_row(x: float, y: float, lg: Array) -> void:
120: 	var src := str(lg[0])
121: 	var dmg := int(lg[1])
122: 	var is_magic := int(lg[2]) == 1
123: 	var crit := int(lg[3]) == 1
124: 	var skill := str(lg[4])
125: 	var ago := float(lg[5])
126: 	_text(Vector2(x + 24, y + 16.0), src, 15, Color(1, 1, 1))
127: 	var dcol := Color(1.0, 0.83, 0.2) if crit else (Color(0.7, 0.42, 0.95) if is_magic else Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.2))
128: 	_text(Vector2(x + 148, y + 16.0), "-%d" % dmg, 15, dcol)
129: 	if crit:
130: 		_text(Vector2(x + 236, y + 16.0), "暴击!", 13, Color(1.0, 0.93, 0.35))
131: 	_text(Vector2(x + 296, y + 16.0), skill, 14, Color(0.75, 0.78, 0.85))
132: 	_text(Vector2(x + PANEL_W - 132, y + 16.0), "%.1fs前" % ago, 12, Color(0.62, 0.7, 0.82))
133: 
134: func _draw_source_block(x: float, y: float, row: Dictionary) -> void:
135: 	var src := str(row["src"])
136: 	var total := int(row["total"]); var phys := int(row["phys"]); var mag := int(row["mag"])
137: 	_text(Vector2(x + 24, y + 24.0), src, 18, Color(1, 1, 1))
138: 	var bars: Array = row["bars"]
139: 	if bars.is_empty():
140: 		return
141: 	var bw := (PANEL_W - 48.0) / maxf(bars.size(), 1)
142: 	var bx := x + 24.0
143: 	var col_max := 0.0
144: 	for b in bars:
145: 		col_max = maxf(col_max, float(b[1]) + float(b[2]))
146: 	var cy := y + 44.0
147: 	for b in bars:
148: 		var key := str(b[0]); var pv := float(b[1]); var mv := float(b[2])
149: 		var st := pv + mv
150: 		var bar_h := maxf(4.0, st / maxf(col_max, 1.0) * BAR_H)
151: 		var by := cy + BAR_H - bar_h
152: 		if pv > 0.0:
153: 			var ph_h := pv / st * bar_h
154: 			draw_rect(Rect2(bx, by, BAR_W, ph_h), Color(1.0, 0.65, 0.2, 0.9))
155: 			by += ph_h
156: 		if mv > 0.0:
157: 			var mg_h := mv / st * bar_h
158: 			draw_rect(Rect2(bx, by, BAR_W, mg_h), Color(0.6, 0.4, 0.9, 0.9))
159: 		draw_rect(Rect2(bx, cy, BAR_W, BAR_H), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.2), false, 1.5)
160: 		_text(Vector2(bx, cy - 8.0), str(int(st)), 15, Color(1, 1, 1))
161: 		_text(Vector2(bx, cy + BAR_H + 20.0), key, 15, Color(0.8, 0.8, 0.8))
162: 		bx += bw
163: 	_text(Vector2(x + 24, cy + BAR_H + 48.0), "  总计: %d (物理:%d 法术:%d)" % [total, phys, mag], 15, Color(0.8, 0.85, 0.9))
164: 
165: # ---------- 输入 ----------

167: func _unhandled_input(ev: InputEvent) -> void:
168: 	if not (ev is InputEventKey and (ev as InputEventKey).pressed and not (ev as InputEventKey).echo):
169: 		return

608: func _tag_label(text: String, bg: Color, fg: Color, wide: int = 0) -> Panel:
609: 	var pill = Panel.new()
610: 	var tw = int(round(15 * _ui_scale()))
611: 	pill.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(maxi(wide, text.length() * tw + int(10 * _ui_scale())), int(round(19 * _ui_scale())))
612: 	pill.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
613: 	pill.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _box_style(bg, bg.lightened(0.35), 0, int(6 * _ui_scale())))
614: 	var lbl = _fill(Label.new(), pill, 4, 0, 4, 0)
615: 	lbl.text = text

859: 	cell.add_child(bar)

862: func _calc_team_maxes(heroes: Array) -> Dictionary:
863: 	var maxes = {}
864: 	var team_total_kills = 0
865: 	var team_total_damage = 0.0
866: 	var team_total_gold = 0
867: 	for h in heroes:
868: 		if h is Hero:
869: 			team_total_kills += h.kills
870: 			team_total_damage += h.damage_dealt_to_heroes + h.turret_damage
871: 			team_total_gold += h.total_gold_earned
872: 	for h in heroes:
873: 		if h is Hero:
874: 			var participation = (float(h.kills + h.assists) / max(1, team_total_kills)) * 100.0
875: 			var damage_pct = ((h.damage_dealt_to_heroes + h.turret_damage) / max(1.0, team_total_damage)) * 100.0
876: 			var gold_pct = (float(h.total_gold_earned) / max(1, team_total_gold)) * 100.0
877: 			var conversion = damage_pct / max(0.01, gold_pct)
878: 
879: 			maxes["对英雄伤害"] = max(maxes.get("对英雄伤害", 1.0), h.damage_dealt_to_heroes)
880: 			maxes["承受伤害"] = max(maxes.get("承受伤害", 1.0), h.damage_taken_from_heroes)
881: 			maxes["总经济"] = max(maxes.get("总经济", 1.0), float(h.total_gold_earned))
882: 			maxes["参团率"] = max(maxes.get("参团率", 1.0), participation)
883: 			maxes["伤害转化比"] = max(maxes.get("伤害转化比", 0.1), conversion)
884: 			maxes["每死承伤"] = max(maxes.get("每死承伤", 1.0), h.damage_taken_from_heroes / max(1.0, float(h.deaths)))
885: 			maxes["野怪经济"] = max(maxes.get("野怪经济", 1.0), float(h.jungle_gold))
886: 			maxes["补刀数"] = max(maxes.get("补刀数", 1), h.last_hits)
887: 			maxes["控制时长"] = max(maxes.get("控制时长", 0.1), h.cc_duration_dealt)
888: 			maxes["治疗量"] = max(maxes.get("治疗量", 1.0), h.healing_done)
889: 			maxes["对塔伤害"] = max(maxes.get("对塔伤害", 1.0), h.turret_damage)
890: 	return maxes

892: func _get_hero_stats(hero: Hero) -> Array:
893: 	var team_heroes = team_player_heroes if hero.team == Config.Team.PLAYER else team_enemy_heroes
894: 	var team_total_kills = 0
895: 	var team_total_damage = 0.0
896: 	var team_total_gold = 0
897: 	for h in team_heroes:
898: 		if h is Hero:
899: 			team_total_kills += h.kills
900: 			team_total_damage += h.damage_dealt_to_heroes + h.turret_damage
901: 			team_total_gold += h.total_gold_earned
902: 
903: 	var participation = (float(hero.kills + hero.assists) / max(1, team_total_kills)) * 100.0
904: 	var damage_pct = ((hero.damage_dealt_to_heroes + hero.turret_damage) / max(1.0, team_total_damage)) * 100.0
905: 	var gold_pct = (float(hero.total_gold_earned) / max(1, team_total_gold)) * 100.0

907: 	var damage_per_death = hero.damage_taken_from_heroes / max(1.0, float(hero.deaths))

920: 		hero.turret_damage

988: func _find_mvp(heroes: Array) -> Hero:
989: 	var best: Hero = null
990: 	var best_score = -1.0
991: 	for h in heroes:
992: 		if h is Hero:
993: 			var s = _calculate_rating(h)
994: 			if s > best_score:
995: 				best_score = s
996: 				best = h
997: 	return best

999: func _calculate_rating(hero: Hero) -> float:
1000: 	var team_heroes = team_player_heroes if hero.team == Config.Team.PLAYER else team_enemy_heroes
1001: 
1002: 	var team_max_kills = 1
1003: 	var team_max_damage = 1.0
1004: 	var team_max_gold = 1
1005: 	var team_max_taken = 1.0
1006: 	var team_total_kills = 0
1007: 	var max_deaths = 1

```gdscript
const SIZE_V := 100.0
func _us() -> float: ...
func _draw():
	if not _active: return
	var vp := get_viewport(); if vp == null: return
	var rs := _us()
	var area := vp.get_visible_rect().size
	var sz := SIZE_V * rs
	var r := Rect2(area * 0.5 - Vector2(sz, sz) * 0.5, Vector2(sz, sz))
	# 背景暗色圆
	draw_circle(r.get_center(), sz * 0.5, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55))
	# 顺时针进度扇形（蓝，同 host fill 0.15,0.4,0.95,0.75）
	var frac := clampf(_ratio, 0.0, 1.0)
	if frac > 0.0:
		var pts := PackedVector2Array()
		pts.append(r.get_center())
		var steps := maxi(3, int(48.0 * frac))
		for i in range(steps + 1):
			var ang := -PI * 0.5 + TAU * frac * float(i) / float(steps)
			pts.append(r.get_center() + Vector2(cos(ang), sin(ang)) * sz * 0.5)
		draw_colored_polygon(pts, Color(0.15, 0.4, 0.95, 0.75))
	# 剩余秒数（同 host recall_label：%.1fs，字号 14×rs）
	var txt := "%.1fs" % ((1.0 - frac) * 7.0)
	var fs := int(round(14.0 * rs))
	var tw := _f.get_string_size(txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs).x
	var pos := Vector2(r.get_center().x - tw * 0.5, r.get_center().y + fs * 0.36)
	draw_string_outline(_f, pos, txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, 2, Color.BLACK)
	draw_string(_f, pos, txt, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, Color.WHITE)
```

```gdscript
		var font: Font = ThemeDB.fallback_font
		var title_h := float(font.get_height(18))
		var dfs := 14
		var text_w := INFO_W - 30.0
```

```gdscript
		var font: Font = ThemeDB.fallback_font
		var us := _us()
		var tfs := int(round(18 * us))
		var dfs := int(round(14 * us))
		var title_h := float(font.get_height(tfs))
		var text_w := INFO_W - 30.0
```

Also `_info_title` y position uses 10 + title_h + 4 fine.

Note host positions title at y=10, size (text_w, title_h). Client desc position = (15, 10+title_h+4). OK.

2. `_text(...)` with `"胜" if is_win else "负"` inline — passing expression fine.
3. `var my_sum := _team_sums(...)` — inferred Dictionary ✓.
4. `_text(Vector2(...), "我方击杀 %d : %d  ·  本场总经济 %s" % [ ... ], int(round(17.0*rs)), Color(...))` — multi-line array formatting is fine in GDScript (inside brackets).
5. `for s in range(6): var filled := s < eq.size() and str(eq[s]) != ""` — `s < eq.size()` int vs int ✓; But careful: `eq[s]` when s >= size — short-circuit `and` evaluates left first, so safe ✓ (same as before).

content.text: Team message from lead:

分析任务（只读，不改任何文件）：逐个英雄排查「技能动画/表现设计」，产出紧凑表给 lead。

范围：**沈梦溪、安琪拉、妲己、小乔、鲁班七号、夏侯惇、后羿、李元芳、元流之子、大禹、王昭君、刘禅、孙悟空、英睿**（14 个）。

每个英雄 3 个技能，逐技能给：技能名/type → ①技能动作（`Hero._cast_anim_name` 规则：近战=attack-melee-right、双手=holding-both-shoot、单手=holding-right-shoot、type4=sprint、type6=interact-right；确认该英雄落在哪类）②视觉表现（元素 `Vfx.HERO_ELEMENT`、形状 `SpellFxTable.get_skill_shape`/ULTS、实体道具 `SKILL_PROPS`、`Vfx.play_spell` 分支）③是否有专属代码（`SkillDataBase.gd` 里 `"英雄":` 的 match skill_id 块、`Hero.gd` 里 display_name 专属 VFX/动画调用、HeroPassive.gd）④问题（如：三个技能共用同一段施法动作、无蓄力/收招、只有通用 bolt/zone 无道具、命中反馈通用、对敌预警缺失、音效回退通用）⑤一条具体优化建议（能落到文件/函数的）。

参考文件：`scripts/core/SpellFxTable.gd`（16 个签名大招 + 8 英雄道具）、`scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd`、`assets/SkillDataBase.gd`、`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`、`scripts/entities/HeroPassive.gd`。已知：`_cast_anim_name` 仅 5 种 clip；`CAST_ANIM_MELEE`/`CAST_ANIM_TWOHAND` 决定用哪套；前摇按 type 默认 0.14/0.20/0.16/0.10/0.10s。

输出格式（send_message 给 lead，不要写文件）：
1) 一张表：`英雄 | 技能1 | 技能2 | 技能3(大招) | 动作clip | 专属表现(文件:行) | 主要问题`，每格 ≤20 字，专属表现写行号即可。
2) 该 14 英雄里「专属表现较好」TOP3 与「同质化最严重」TOP3，各一句话理由。
3) 3-5 条组内共性问题（跨英雄）。
不要弹通知、不要改文件、不要启动游戏窗口；总字数控制在 1200 字内。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

## Primary Request and Intent
- Act as UI replication engineer for Godot 4.7 GDScript project HonorKing (MOBA), working dir `C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king` (no git, no rollback — be careful).
- Single-player (host) UI is built in `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` (~3480 lines); net client re-implements via self-drawn Controls. User complained online vs single-player panels "不太一样". Hero info + shop panels are owned by other teammates (NetRosterPanel.gd / NetShopPanel.gd); this agent owns **all other panels**.
- Step 1: claim shared task `task-3` (read latest revision → claim). Task description holds full acceptance criteria.
- Only allowed to modify these 8 files (nothing else — especially not `NetClientBattle.gd`, `NetSession.gd`, `UI_Manager.gd`, `NetShopPanel.gd`, `NetRosterPanel.gd`):

- Root cause (confirmed): host Label/RichText font sizes pass through `_apply_label_style`/`_apply_rich_label_style` → `font_size × ui_scale()`, where `ui_scale()=maxf(1.0, viewport_width/2400.0)*1.35` (1.35 at 2400 width), while positions/offsets mostly stay raw pixels. Client hardcoded raw font sizes → ~26% smaller. Requirement: per file add private helper (e.g. `func _us() -> float:`) replicating the formula and change all host font sizes to `host_size × _us()`; multiply positions only where host source does.
- Method mandated: grep-locate host functions → read with offset/limit → targeted edits; keep public APIs and parent call sites unchanged; do not start the game window; do not notify the user.
- Validation command: `cd 'C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king'; & 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path . --editor --quit` — only the pre-existing Minimap class-name conflict warning is allowed; no new SCRIPT ERROR / Parse Error.

- Godot 4.7, GDScript, Control-drawn UI (`_draw`, `draw_string`, `draw_string_outline`, `draw_rect`, `draw_circle`, `draw_arc`, `draw_colored_polygon`), CanvasLayer layering (40 kill feed, 42 recall, 55 target, 60 buff row, 65 recommend bar, 70 death recap, 110 result, 104 yuanliu).

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

content.text: Team message from lead:

新任务（HonorKing 工作区 C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king，Godot 4.7.2）：UI 打磨 4 项，**你负责单机侧**。用户原话：「右上角金币和装备推荐购买的太小了，导致很难点到；可购买推荐装备时该装备图标四周应该有一圈发光拖尾旋转（技能的加号也需要实现这样的效果）；全局英雄面板在手机端看字太小了；删除英雄头像上方英雄的名字和等级」。

【写作用域】只改 `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd`（含内部类 RecItemCard / SkillIcon / RespawnWidget）+ `scripts/ui/RosterView.gd` + `scripts/ui/HeroInfoControl.gd`（若需要）。**不要改** UiKit.gd、WorldBarPainter.gd、HealthBarControl.gd、任何 `scripts/net/*`、任何 `scripts/core/*`（联机侧由别人并行做，避免冲突）。

【4 项需求（单机侧）】
1) **右上角金币芯片 + 推荐装备卡 / “+” 快速购买整体放大，显著提高可点性**：
   - 现状：`UI_Manager.gd` 约 645-687 行，金币 chip 偏移 `-250..-45`（宽 205、高 37，字号 17），`rec_card` `-410..-20`（高 84），`buy_plus_btn` 约 68×72。
   - 目标：金币 chip 高度 ≥ 54、字号 ≥ 22；推荐卡整体高度 ≥ 108、内部图标/名称/价格字号同比放大；“+” 按钮点击区 ≥ 96×96、`+` 字号 ≥ 72。三者**互不重叠**（金币在上、推荐卡在下、+在推荐卡右侧），并保持右侧对齐与 `UiKit.apply_safe_top` 刘海避让逻辑仍生效。触摸命中区要等于或大于视觉区（`mouse_filter=STOP` 的 Control 尺寸即可）。
2) **可购买推荐装备时：装备图标四周一圈发光拖尾旋转**：在 `RecItemCard._draw` 里加旋转光环拖尾（沿图标外接圆画 2~3 段渐变弧/拖尾，随时间旋转、尾端淡出、暖金色发光，可叠加 `draw_arc` + 少量发光点）；`_process(delta)` 里推进相位（仅当“可购买/可合成”状态为真时动画与绘制，否则不画、停止 `set_process`）。**技能图标的“+”升级标记同样加这圈旋转发光**：`SkillIcon` 里现有“+”绘制处（grep `+` 相关 `_draw`、`can_upgrade`/`plus` 状态）加同款旋转光环。注意 60fps 下不要每帧新建资源（复用 Color/Mesh 不适用；纯 draw 即可）。
3) **全局英雄面板（C 键 RosterView）手机端字号放大**：把面板内所有文字字号整体上调约 20~30%（英雄名、分路/职责标签、KDA、装备名、标题等），并同步放大行高/列宽避免挤字或溢出；`RosterView.gd` 内若有按 `UiKit.FS_*` 取字号的，直接改实际字号常量。保证 2400×1400（ui_scale 1.35）下不重叠、不超出面板。
4) **删除英雄头像上方的英雄名字和等级**：在全局英雄面板里每个英雄头像上方绘制/显示的“名字 + 等级（Lv.x）”去掉；头像本身与其余信息（职责/装备/KDA 等）保留，注意别留突兀空白或错位。若该名字/等级是面板里唯一的身份标识，改为不使用“头像上方”位置即可（例如并到同一行文字），不要造成信息缺失歧义。

【规范】中文一行注释；最小 diff；不重构无关代码；不改数值平衡；不 commit；不弹通知（Lead 统一发）；临时探针 `_probe_*` 用完删除（含 .import/.uid），最终 `git status --porcelain` 不得有你的 `_probe` 残留。

【验证】
- `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe --headless --path . --editor --quit` → exit 0，无 SCRIPT ERROR/Parse Error。
- 冒烟：`--headless --path . scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 420` → exit 0 无 SCRIPT ERROR。
- 量化证据（必须）：打印/截取改造后金币 chip 尺寸、推荐卡尺寸、“+”按钮尺寸（新旧对比）；`RecItemCard` 在“可购买”与“不可购买”两种状态下的绘制分支（可用探针直接 `card._draw()` 或检查状态变量）；RosterView 改造前后字号数值。
- 视觉验证（建议，窗口化运行 + `get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png()`，可用 `UiManager` 强制显示面板）截图 1~2 张到 `screenshots/`，并在报告里给出路径。

【交付】send_message 给 lead：一句话结论；改动 `路径:行号` + 一句说明；验证命令/exit code/新旧数值对比；未做项与原因。不要贴大段代码。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.
